content: MVP vertical slice completed: atomic create/open/save/migration; WAV import/managed assets/waveform cache; real-time lock-free playback; modern native GUI sample editor; structured JSON CLI; and shared PCM16/float32 offline WAV export. Each child has acceptance evidence and its own commit. Final full gate: `cargo quality` passed with 44 tests plus format, Clippy -D warnings, and bench compilation. Real demo asset import/add/export smoke succeeded.
